item.title: Three Slides for Slow Sundays

turns.text: Make 3 square Instagram carousel slides that look like a set for a cosy café. Text, in order: 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', 'Stay a little longer'. Warm cream and coffee-brown colours, simple illustrations. Give me the three separate slides, ready to post.

item.tests: Tests delivery of three individually usable carousel slides with correct ordered copy and a cohesive visual system.

answer_sheet.Slide count and delivery: Three separate image files, in the requested order; not one combined strip.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
answer_sheet.Exact wording: Slide 1: Slow Sunday. Slide 2: Coffee first. Slide 3: Stay a little longer.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Cosy café mood, warm cream and coffee-brown palette, simple illustrations, coordinated typography and layout.

must_haves: There are exactly three separate square slides, not a contact sheet.
The slides read, in order, 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', and 'Stay a little longer'.
All three use a recognizably shared cream-and-coffee-brown palette and typography.
Each slide includes simple café-related illustration rather than only plain text.
All wording is readable and fully inside the slide boundaries.

turns.text: Make 3 square Instagram carousel slides that look like a set for a cosy café. Text, in order: 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', 'Stay a little longer'. Warm cream and coffee-brown colours, simple illustrations. Give me the three separate slides, ready to post. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.

**Lowest-cost option for three separate, ready-to-post slides:** use a free-plan image model at **640 × 640 px**, one image per slide. Listed pricing starts at **5 credits per image—15 credits total estimated**. I can’t verify your balance or an exact account-specific quote with the tools available here.

The set would share a warm cream background, coffee-brown lettering, and simple café illustrations:
1. **“Slow Sunday”** — a steaming mug and a small sun
2. **“Coffee first”** — a coffee cup and scattered beans
3. **“Stay a little longer”** — a cosy café chair and table

**Cheaper alternative:** generate all three designs on one sheet, starting at **5 credits**, but you’d need to crop it into separate slides, with lower detail per slide. That wouldn’t meet your ready-to-post requirement as neatly.

640 px is the smallest available image setting; shorter wording won’t reduce the per-image cost. It’s postable, though below Instagram’s usual 1080 × 1080 size.

**Would you like me to proceed with the three separate slides at an estimated 15 credits?**

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the first generation attempt because of **insufficient credits**. No slides were generated, and **no generation credits were spent**.

I won’t retry and risk further charges. The 15-credit figure was an estimate, not a verified account quote—sorry for that limitation.

A **zero-credit alternative** is for me to create three matching SVG designs here with your exact text. You’d need to export them to PNG before posting, but that would avoid Magic Hour credits entirely.

Crisp finished ready-to-post design.
